ui.title: Simulator
ui.sites_playshelf: Your game library, on the console
ui.sites_atlas: A map of every game, on every platform
ui.sites_lantern: The protocol between servers and consoles
ui.save_data: Data saver is on: PlayGuard is a few megabytes to download.
ui.theme_changed: The theme changed: restart to give it to the console too.
ui.other_help: Any other PLAYGUARD_SIM_* variable, by its name in lower case without the prefix: one this page does not know yet (from a newer build) still reaches PlayGuard.
ui.note: Apply restarts PlayGuard from a fresh state with these settings; what you change inside it is not kept, unless “Keep the state” is on. The console takes the page's language and theme.
ui.keys: <kbd>↑↓←→</kbd> move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> A · <kbd>Esc</kbd> B · <kbd>X</kbd> <kbd>Y</kbd> · <kbd>L</kbd> <kbd>R</kbd> · <kbd>⇧L</kbd> ZL · <kbd>⇧R</kbd> ZR · <kbd>+</kbd> <kbd>−</kbd> · a click is a touch
ui.no_isolation: This browser does not let the page run threads (no cross-origin isolation). Try a recent Chrome, Edge or Firefox, outside a private window.
ui.no_webgl: This browser has no WebGL 2, which PlayGuard draws with.
ui.time_help: Moves the console's time on, a game played all along: the time left goes down by as much (skip=).
ui.console_suspended: time's up: the game is suspended
ui.console_warning: time's up, a warning only: {t} over
ui.console_living: counts in real time, kept between visits
ui.console_restart_help: As a real restart: a temporary unlock ends, the time played stays
ui.console_restricted_toast: Time's up: the console suspends play
ui.console_warning_toast: Time's up: the console only warns, play goes on
ui.steps_help: A link that starts PlayGuard as it started here and replays what you did since
ui.tour_overview: Today: today's play time, the limit, the time left and bedtime.
ui.tour_play_timer: Play timer: the week chart is the editor, one limit for every day or one per day.
ui.tour_activity: Activity: who played what, and how long, from the console's own log.
ui.tour_console: Console: the network clock, the installed games and what the console runs.
ui.tour_time: Time passes: an hour of play later, today's time is used up.
ui.tour_end: Your turn: the arrows move, Enter is A, Esc is B. The panel sets any state.

keep.label: Keep the state between visits
keep.help: PlayGuard's data and the simulated console's settings (PIN, limits, clocks) stay in this browser; the console settings of this panel then count for a first start only. With it the console lives on: its time played today counts in real time and stays too, and Restart the console ends a temporary unlock.

alarm_only.label: When time is up: a warning only
alarm_only.help: With the limit reached, the time left reads below 0.

not_counting.label: Time left not going down
not_counting.help: A clock set back: Today says so after 90 s on screen.

fw.label: Firmware
fw.help: Above the newest verified one, the firmware screen.

sd_free_mb.label: SD card free space (MB)
sd_free_mb.help: Under 500 MB, the Console tab warns.

hbloader.label: A loader that can hand an update to a store

skip.label: Console time moved on by (s)
skip.help: A game played all along: the time left goes down by as much. The buttons under the screen move it on.

accounts.label: User accounts
accounts.help: 0 to 8 (2 by default), each playing twice as much as the next one.

latest.label: Latest release : newest firmware it supports

store.label: The Homebrew App Store's version (with its record on the SD card)

presets.fw_old: Firmware too old for the play timer
